sources.note: Tactical Breach Wizards: action phase, foresee phase shows how it pays off, actions can be reset until end turn
Jagged Alliance 2: turn-based when an enemy is spotted; mercs stand a chance of interrupting; action success dictated by statistics

options.how: 47 and the guards are board-game counters on a visible grid; you solve each level as a turn-based puzzle within a move limit
Shots roll against a chance to hit, and soldiers see only 9 tiles at night while aliens see 20, so threats hide in the dark

sources.note: Hitman GO: turn-based tactics, board-game style, grid levels, 47 and enemies as counters, finish within limited moves
X-COM: UFO Defense: soldiers see 20 tiles by day and 9 at night; aliens 20 at all times
X-COM: UFO Defense: firing accuracy and base chance to hit

options.how: Hits raise a damage percentage that increases knockback; fighters are launched off the stage rather than wounded
X-Ray moves zoom in to show bones and organs crushed and snapped, and Fatalities finish the beaten opponent

sources.note: Super Smash Bros. Melee: as the damage meter goes up so does knockback; launch distance
Mortal Kombat (2011): X-Ray shows bones and organs crushed, smashed and snapped

options.how: The GHOUL system lets shots dismember enemies, who then scream over the missing limbs
Cartoon art; in Pyroland, gibs turn into toys and blood into balloons, streamers and confetti

sources.note: Soldier of Fortune: GHOUL system allows you to dismember enemies; ESRB Animated Blood and Gore
Team Fortress 2: Pyroland gibs become toys, blood effects become balloons, streamers and confetti

options.how: X-ray kill cam replays kills in slow motion with bones cracking, now including melee attacks and explosive trap kills
Characters, world and combat sync to the music in a colorful cartoon style; hits read as rhythm spectacle, not injury detail

sources.note: Sniper Elite 4: X-ray kill cam in bone-cracking detail
Hi-Fi Rush: characters, world and combat sync to the music, stylized cartoony look

options.how: A persistent blood system keeps gore on the map while entrails and severed limbs fly from shot zeds
Weapons fire ink: you splat opponents in bright colors and they respawn, a fight rated only as cartoon violence

sources.note: Killing Floor 2: persistent blood system; entrails, severed limbs and blood flying
Splatoon 3: ink, swim and splat with ink-filled weapons; rated Cartoon Violence

options.how: Timed parries block melee and bullets; a perfect parry restores health and opens a counter
The dodge roll carries you through bullet patterns; flipping tables adds temporary cover

sources.note: Furi: sword fighting and dual-stick shooting; parry details not on the store page
Enter the Gungeon: shoot, loot, dodge roll and table-flip

options.how: A monomolecular katana is your weapon: you close distance to slice enemies, dodging bullets on the way in
Soul Cards are guns (pistol, rifle, machine gun, shotgun, uzi) with limited ammo; the katana card is the fallback

sources.note: Ghostrunner: slice enemies with a monomolecular katana, dodge bullets with superhuman reflexes
Neon White: Soul Cards serve as limited-use weapons: pistol, rifle, machine gun, uzi, shotgun; Katana card

options.how: In Guard mode you hold a stance in one of three directions; reading where the enemy guards and strikes from decides blocks and hits
Two basic attack buttons combine into Combo Attack skills; color-coded enemy tells call for parry, Blink, dodge or Repulse

sources.note: For Honor: triangular stance indicator, attacks come from a given direction, Guard mode needed to block
Stellar Blade: basic attacks combine into Combo Attack skills; parry, Blink, Perfect Dodge and Repulse answer colored tells

options.how: Holding block absorbs hits at a stamina cost; pressing it when the green shield shows makes a free Perfect Block
The dash is the core defense; upgrades add Chain Dash and Bullet Absorb, and there is no shield to hold

sources.note: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II: blocking depletes stamina; Perfect Block on the green shield costs no stamina
Hyper Light Drifter: Dash is a starting ability; Chain Dash and Bullet Absorb upgrades

options.how: Soldiers use goal-oriented action planning: each picks actions at runtime to satisfy goals instead of running scripted routines
Every monster type has a fixed movement pattern on the beat, like bats moving every second beat, that you learn and exploit

sources.note: F.E.A.R.: enemy AI built with Goal Oriented Action Planning
Crypt of the NecroDancer: monsters differ in movement patterns; bat moves every second beat

options.how: One to four dwarves mine procedural caves and fight for their lives against alien hordes swarming from the rock
Every fight is one fencer against one fencer, trading lunges and parries for right of way

sources.note: Deep Rock Galactic: 1-4 players, procedurally generated caves, fight for their lives against alien hordes
Nidhogg: two-player fencing showdown with lunges and parries

options.how: Before ending a turn you watch a foresee phase play out your plan, and can reset any action, so outcomes are known in advance
Attacks roll accuracy minus dodge plus crit chance, with hidden internal bonuses (+5 ACC, +4 per consecutive miss) behind the shown odds

sources.note: Tactical Breach Wizards: foresee phase shows how planned actions pay off; actions reset until end turn
Darkest Dungeon: accuracy minus dodge is hit chance; hidden +5 ACC and +4 per consecutive miss; crit chance
